title: Three Stylish Women by 1950s Convertible, July 1956 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: Three stylishly dressed women in 1950s dresses and coats stand smiling next to a convertible parked in front of a suburban home. The upper margin is factory-stamped 'JUL • 56 •', representing quintessential post-war American suburban leisure, mid-century automotive culture, and period fashion.
